pages.text: Petrified Onyx Forest, Withered Forest, Ashen Wastes, Rimefrost Chasm, Quartz Reef and several vanilla biomes. A walled fortress whose four towers hold Ash Wraith spawners and chests. In the middle stands a $(l)three-storey keep$() that you climb:

$(l)1.$() Great hall: knights and Ember Stalker spawners; stairs along the west wall. $(l)2.$() Armory, library (chests, a mimic) and the $(l)sealed vault$() in the centre. $(l)3.$() Under the roof, the arena of the $(l)Onyx Sentinel$(), with balconies (wraiths, chests, mimics). Kill it, then go back down to the vault.
